title: Calais Campbell still loves football at 39, expects 19th NFL season with Ravens to be his last

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Calais Campbell still loves football at 39, expects 19th NFL season with Ravens to be his last
sources.description: Calais Campbell is 39 years old with an accomplished résumé and $150 million in career earnings. He says love of the game keeps bringing him back.
